name: describe-room
description: Reads a room being saved as a component: says what its way of working depends on, drafts its instructions from the conversation and its Library entry (name, description, category, tags, welcome), and flags what in the package's text should not leave the room: secrets, internal links, people's names, private data.

fields.name: displayName
fields.description: The component's name in the Library

fields.name: description
fields.description: One or two sentences: what a room made from it is for

fields.name: category
fields.description: One lower-case word for its kind of work

fields.name: welcome
fields.description: What a new room made from it says first

fields.name: instructions
fields.description: The room's instructions as the conversation established them, plain text or Markdown

fields.name: dependsOn
fields.description: What the room's way of working relies on, one item each

item.name: what
item.description: Its name, as <text> or the conversation gives it

item.name: kind
item.description: instructions, app, file, tool, schedule, agent, data or other

item.name: included
item.description: yes when the package should carry it, no when it cannot or should not

item.name: why
item.description: One short sentence: what it gives the room, or why it stays out

fields.name: findings
fields.description: Text of the package that should not leave the room, one item each; none when nothing should not

item.name: field
item.description: Where it is: a key of the package in <text>, exactly as given

item.name: quote
item.description: The words in question, as written, at most 80 characters

item.name: why
item.description: secret, internal-link, personal-name or private-data, a colon, then one short sentence
